title: Analysis of urine samples from patients with impaired kidney function
summary: Galectin-3 binding protein is a protein that is excreted in the urine in various diseases and may help to predict the course of the disease. This is particularly the case in patients with lupus nephritis, an inflammation of the kidneys associated with the autoimmune disease systemic lupus erythematosus. The aim is to examine the galectin-3 binding protein in patients with impaired kidney function in more detail, particularly with regard to its three-dimensional structure. For comparison, urine from healthy participants will be examined. Urine collection will be non-invasive and carried out as part of routine diagnostics, so that patients do not have to make a special appointment. After collection, the urine will be prepared for further processing and analysis using electron microscopy.

interventions.name: Protein analysis in patients with impaired kidney function by electron microscopy.
